items.reason_zh: ADIN2111/ADIN1110 以太网驱动程序中的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许畸形帧破坏内核内存，危及基于 Zephyr 构建的车载和工业物联网网络协议栈。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in Zephyr's IPv4 port parser allows attackers to overwrite stack memory via crafted address strings, compromising constrained IoT endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr 的 IPv4 端口解析器中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，攻击者可通过构造的地址字符串覆盖栈内存，破坏资源受限物联网终端的完整性。

items.reason_en: WireGuard payload linearization flaw can corrupt fixed pool buffers during decryption, breaking secure communication channels in IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: WireGuard 载荷线性化缺陷在解密过程中可能破坏固定池缓冲区，导致物联网网关的安全通信通道中断。

items.reason_en: Socket recvmsg() validation bypass permits out-of-bounds writes via crafted ancillary data, enabling remote code execution on networked IoT devices.
items.reason_zh: Socket recvmsg() 验证绕过漏洞允许通过构造的辅助数据进行越界写入，从而在网络化物联网设备上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Zephyr's dynamic kernel-object tracking corrupts object lists, destabilizing real-time scheduling and memory safety in embedded IoT kernels.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr 动态内核对象跟踪机制中的竞态条件会破坏对象列表，导致嵌入式物联网内核的实时调度和内存安全性失稳。

items.reason_en: Mitigates a buffer overflow in the ath12k Wi-Fi driver's debugfs interface, protecting IoT gateways and edge routers from local privilege escalation via accessible debug endpoints.
items.reason_zh: 缓解 ath12k Wi-Fi 驱动程序 debugfs 接口中的缓冲区溢出漏洞，保护物联网网关和边缘路由器免受通过可访问调试端点引发的本地权限提升攻击。

items.reason_en: Prevents ACPI firmware-induced kernel crashes by refusing to evaluate methods with missing arguments, enhancing stability and security for embedded IoT hardware platforms.
items.reason_zh: 通过拒绝评估缺少参数的方法来防止由 ACPI 固件引发的内核崩溃，增强嵌入式物联网硬件平台的稳定性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Fixes unsafe RCU usage in RDMA implicit ODP handling, preventing kernel panics in IoT/edge servers that rely on high-performance direct memory access fabrics.
items.reason_zh: 修复 RDMA 隐式 ODP 处理中不安全的 RCU 使用问题，防止依赖高性能 DMA 互连架构的物联网/边缘服务器发生内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: MDIO bus driver lacks parameter verification for PHY read/write operations, enabling out-of-bounds access on embedded network interfaces.
items.reason_zh: MDIO 总线驱动程序缺乏对 PHY 读写操作的参数验证，导致嵌入式网络接口出现越界访问漏洞。

items.reason_en: SPI IMX controller driver ignores setup transfer errors, leading to NULL pointer dereferences in embedded communication stacks.
items.reason_zh: SPI IMX 控制器驱动程序忽略建立传输错误，导致嵌入式通信栈中出现空指针解引用漏洞。

items.reason_en: USB xHCI host controller mishandles isochronous ring events, causing data underruns/overruns that break real-time IoT peripheral synchronization.
items.reason_zh: USB xHCI 主机控制器错误处理等时环事件，导致数据欠载或过载，破坏物联网外设的实时同步。

items.reason_en: Ath12k WiFi driver invalid ring entry fetch crashes firmware monitoring, impacting reliability of connected IoT edge gateways.
items.reason_zh: Ath12k Wi-Fi 驱动程序无效获取环表项会导致固件监控崩溃，影响所连接物联网边缘网关的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Exploits hardcoded credentials in Jooan IP cameras to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution, a critical flaw commonly found in embedded surveillance devices.
items.reason_zh: 利用 Jooan IP 摄像头中的硬编码凭据实现未认证远程代码执行，这是嵌入式监控设备中常见的关键漏洞。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication and authorization checks on health-data endpoints allow attackers to read and modify sensitive patient records via predictable resource IDs.
items.reason_zh: 健康数据端点缺失认证和授权检查，使攻击者能够通过可预测的资源 ID 读取和修改敏感患者记录。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to guest order invoices enables privacy leakage and sequential ID enumeration in IoT-enabled e-commerce platforms.
items.reason_zh: 对访客订单发票的未认证访问可导致隐私泄露及顺序 ID 枚举，此类漏洞常见于支持物联网的电子商务平台。

items.reason_en: An integer underflow in the MT7601U WiFi driver causes null pointer dereferences, severely impacting connectivity and stability in IoT network devices.
items.reason_zh: MT7601U Wi-Fi 驱动程序中的整数下溢漏洞会导致空指针解引用，严重损害物联网网络设备的连接性与稳定性。

items.reason_en: The Ath11k WiFi driver crashes during peer initialization under high virtual AP loads, posing significant reliability risks for IoT routers and access points.
items.reason_zh: Ath11k Wi-Fi 驱动程序在高虚拟 AP 负载下进行对等体初始化时发生崩溃，给物联网路由器和接入点带来重大可靠性风险。

items.reason_en: Port power management reinit failure causes kernel oopses on serial unbind, critical for IoT gateway reliability.
items.reason_zh: 端口电源管理重新初始化失败会在串口解绑时引发内核 Oops 错误，严重影响物联网网关的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Intel ISH HID IPC work function triggers on reset notifications, compromising sensor hub security.
items.reason_zh: Intel ISH HID IPC 工作函数中的释放后使用漏洞在收到重置通知时被触发，危及传感器集线器的安全性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in IPMI user destruction affects BMC management interfaces commonly deployed in edge and IoT infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: IPMI 用户销毁过程中的释放后使用漏洞会影响通常部署于边缘和物联网基础设施中的 BMC 管理接口。

items.reason_en: The EnergizeLab AI skill upload endpoint lacks authentication and path constraints, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution via path traversal.
items.reason_zh: EnergizeLab AI 技能上传端点缺乏认证和路径约束，允许未认证攻击者通过路径遍历实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: EnergizeLab firmware ships with default root credentials and enabled SSH, granting any network-accessible attacker full administrative control of the device.
items.reason_zh: EnergizeLab 固件出厂时携带默认 root 凭据并启用 SSH，任何具备网络访问权限的攻击者均可获得设备的完整管理员控制权。

items.reason_en: QNAP Video Station suffers from a path traversal vulnerability that permits authenticated users to read sensitive system files and data outside the intended application directory.
items.reason_zh: QNAP Video Station 存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证用户读取预期应用目录之外的敏感系统文件和数据。

items.reason_en: The Zephyr NXP MCUX TRNG entropy driver passes raw byte counts directly to the SDK, potentially compromising cryptographic randomness on i.MX RT5xx/RT6xx microcontrollers.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr NXP MCUX TRNG 熵驱动程序将原始字节计数直接传递给 SDK，可能削弱 i.MX RT5xx/RT6xx 微控制器的密码学随机性。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured Bluetooth communication in SwitchBot Door Lock Series allows protocol manipulation to bypass electronic locks, enabling unauthorized physical access.
items.reason_zh: SwitchBot Door Lock Series 的蓝牙通信配置不当允许协议操纵绕过电子锁，从而实现未授权物理访问。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information exposure in Azure IoT Central allows privilege escalation, potentially compromising connected industrial devices and telemetry pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure IoT Central 中的敏感信息泄露可导致权限提升，进而可能危及已连接工业设备及遥测管道。

items.reason_en: Predictable pre-shared key generation in TP-Link cameras allows adjacent attackers to recover encryption keys and intercept media streams.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link 摄像头中可预测的预共享密钥生成机制使邻近攻击者能够恢复加密密钥并拦截媒体流。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the HTTPS JSON API enables unauthenticated attackers to invoke privileged actions without valid session verification.
items.reason_zh: HTTPS JSON API 的身份验证绕过漏洞使未认证攻击者能够在无有效会话验证的情况下调用特权操作。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the embedded HTTP server permits unauthenticated remote denial of service via crafted Content-Type headers.
items.reason_zh: 嵌入式 HTTP 服务器的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许攻击者通过构造 Content-Type 头发起未认证的远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in QNAP Download Station allows authenticated users to read arbitrary system files on network storage appliances.
items.reason_zh: QNAP Download Station 的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证用户读取网络存储设备上的任意系统文件。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal in QNAP Qsirch exposes sensitive storage configuration and system data.
items.reason_zh: QNAP Qsirch 中的未认证路径遍历漏洞会暴露敏感的存储配置与系统数据。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in QNAP Video Station enables unauthorized extraction of video metadata and internal system information.
items.reason_zh: QNAP Video Station 的授权绕过漏洞使攻击者能够未授权提取视频元数据及内部系统信息。

items.reason_en: Symlink following vulnerability in QNAP QuMagie enables arbitrary file compromise after basic user authentication.
items.reason_zh: QNAP QuMagie 中的符号链接跟随漏洞在通过基本用户认证后可能导致任意文件被攻破。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded symmetric encryption keys in Slican telephone exchange binaries allow attackers to decrypt live telephony traffic.
items.reason_zh: Slican 电话交换机二进制文件中硬编码的对称加密密钥使攻击者能够解密实时语音通信流量。

items.reason_en: Missing length validation in Linux kernel USB gadget audio drivers prevents buffer overflows in connected IoT audio peripherals.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 USB gadget 音频驱动中缺失的长度验证无法防止已连接物联网音频外设的缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free upon character device closure in the Greybus subsystem affects embedded and IoT platforms, potentially allowing local exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Greybus 子系统在字符设备关闭时存在释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，影响嵌入式及物联网平台，可能导致本地利用。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds check in the ACPI CRAT parser can trigger out-of-bounds reads on systems with malformed firmware tables common in edge devices.
items.reason_zh: ACPI CRAT 解析器中缺失的边界检查可能在边缘设备常见的格式错误固件表系统上触发越界读取。

items.reason_en: Remote out-of-bounds read in the router's CGI interface exposes sensitive memory contents and has been actively disclosed, increasing the likelihood of targeted exploitation.
items.reason_zh: 路由器 CGI 接口的远程越界读取漏洞会暴露敏感内存内容，且该漏洞已被公开披露，增加了定向利用的风险。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in the custom reports module allows attackers to extract or manipulate backend data, compromising integrity in building automation and energy management deployments.
items.reason_zh: 自定义报表模块中的 SQL 注入漏洞使攻击者能够提取或篡改后端数据，破坏楼宇自动化与能源管理系统的完整性。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated RFCOMM MCC frame lengths allow remote attackers to trigger out-of-bounds reads via malicious Bluetooth peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 未经验证的 RFCOMM MCC 帧长度允许远程攻击者通过恶意蓝牙外设触发越界读取。

items.reason_en: Missing packet size validation in Thunderbolt XDomain handlers enables physical access attacks leading to memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: Thunderbolt XDomain 处理程序中缺失的数据包大小验证使物理访问攻击得以实施，进而导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Array index out-of-bounds in ath5k Wi-Fi driver can be exploited locally to crash embedded systems or escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: ath5k Wi-Fi 驱动的数组索引越界漏洞可被本地利用以导致嵌入式系统崩溃或实现提权。

items.reason_en: Qualcomm remoteproc MDT loader fails to validate ELF header boundaries, allowing firmware parsing exploits on embedded IoT hardware.
items.reason_zh: Qualcomm remoteproc MDT 加载器未能验证 ELF 头边界，使得攻击者可在嵌入式物联网硬件上利用固件解析漏洞。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds checking in NFC pipe creation permits memory corruption via crafted NFC controller commands, impacting connected IoT peripherals.
items.reason_zh: NFC 管道创建过程中缺失的边界检查可通过构造的 NFC 控制器命令导致内存损坏，进而影响已连接的物联网外设。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Broadcom WiFi driver affects countless IoT devices, enabling local privilege escalation and device compromise.
items.reason_zh: Broadcom WiFi 驱动中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞影响海量物联网设备，可实现本地提权及设备沦陷。

items.reason_en: Improper RCU usage in the WILC1000 driver during connection paths can crash embedded systems or allow unauthorized network access.
items.reason_zh: WILC1000 驱动在连接路径中 RCU 使用不当可能导致嵌入式系统崩溃或允许未授权的网络访问。

items.reason_en: Fast RX entry not cleared on VLAN changes in mac80211 leads to use-after-free, destabilizing wireless IoT gateways and smart home hubs.
items.reason_zh: mac80211 在 VLAN 变更时未清除快速接收（RX）条目会导致释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，致使无线物联网网关和智能家居中枢运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Missing locks in the Xilinx DPDMA driver can cause deadlocks or crashes in FPGA-based edge computing and industrial IoT hardware.
items.reason_zh: Xilinx DPDMA 驱动中缺失的锁机制可能导致基于 FPGA 的边缘计算及工业物联网硬件出现死锁或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service enables unauthenticated network RCE, directly exposing hosted applications and tenant data to external attackers.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 中缺失的身份验证漏洞允许未认证的远程网络命令执行（RCE），直接使托管应用及租户数据暴露给外部攻击者。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Azure SRE Agent allows authenticated network privilege escalation, compromising internal cloud operations and management planes.
items.reason_zh: Azure SRE Agent 中缺失的授权检查允许已认证用户进行网络权限提升，从而危及内部云操作及管理平面。

items.reason_en: Sensitive information exposure in Azure API Center enables unauthorized network data disclosure, risking API key leakage and downstream service abuse.
items.reason_zh: Azure API Center 中的敏感信息泄露会导致未授权的网络数据泄露，增加 API 密钥泄露及下游服务滥用的风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse permits unauthenticated network RCE, threatening core CRM and business application platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse 中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许未认证的远程网络命令执行（RCE），严重威胁核心 CRM 及商业应用平台。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature flaws in AD FS allow spoofing attacks that can compromise enterprise identity management and single sign-on infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中的加密签名缺陷可导致欺骗攻击，进而危及企业身份管理及单点登录基础设施。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in Azure Storage Library allows privilege escalation over the network, directly threatening cloud data storage and management services.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Library 中的注入漏洞允许通过网络进行权限提升，直接威胁云数据存储与管理服务。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver breaks container security boundaries, enabling local privilege escalation in cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver 中的访问控制不当破坏了容器安全边界，导致云工作负载中的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud grants authorized attackers local code execution, threatening cloud workload orchestration and deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可使授权攻击者实现本地代码执行，威胁云工作负载编排与部署流水线。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.2 improper channel restriction in Azure Key Vault could allow attackers to intercept or manipulate sensitive cryptographic operations.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.2 的 Azure Key Vault 通道限制不当漏洞可能使攻击者能够拦截或篡改敏感加密操作。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 integer overflow in SharePoint enables remote code execution, threatening hybrid cloud deployments and enterprise collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 SharePoint 整数溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁混合云部署与企业协作平台。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 incorrect authorization in Exchange Server allows privilege escalation, risking unauthorized access to corporate email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Exchange Server 授权错误漏洞可导致权限提升，危及企业电子邮件基础设施的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 SQL injection in Configuration Manager permits remote attackers to escalate privileges and compromise endpoint management systems.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Configuration Manager SQL 注入漏洞允许远程攻击者提升权限并破坏终端管理系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services can lead to remote code execution, jeopardizing entire domain trust relationships.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 Active Directory Domain Services 授权错误漏洞可能导致远程代码执行，危及整个域信任关系。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation enables unauthorized information disclosure, potentially weakening cloud identity verification.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未授权的信息泄露，可能削弱云身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Azure Attestation enables unauthorized information disclosure, exposing sensitive device health metrics.
items.reason_zh: Azure Attestation 中的越界读取漏洞可导致未授权的信息泄露，暴露敏感的设备健康指标。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure HDInsight exposes sensitive data from managed big data clusters to unauthorized external actors.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight 中的信息泄露漏洞将托管大数据集群中的敏感数据暴露给未授权的外部实体。

items.reason_en: Excessive memory allocation in AD FS enables remote denial of service, disrupting identity federation and single sign-on capabilities for cloud applications.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中的内存分配过量漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，中断云应用的身份联合与单点登录功能。

items.reason_en: Lack of resource throttling in AD FS allows remote denial of service, potentially overwhelming identity providers and blocking user authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中缺乏资源限流机制可导致远程拒绝服务，可能压垮身份提供商并阻断用户认证流程。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in libceph auth session handler allows exploitation via untrusted network packets, threatening distributed cloud storage cluster stability.
items.reason_zh: libceph 认证会话处理程序中的越界写入漏洞可通过不可信网络包进行利用，威胁分布式云存储集群的稳定性。

items.reason_en: BPF verifier stack depth accounting flaw can misclassify program complexity, potentially allowing malicious eBPF filters to bypass isolation mechanisms in cloud hosts.
items.reason_zh: BPF 验证器栈深度计算缺陷可能导致程序复杂度误判，潜在允许恶意 eBPF 过滤器绕过云主机上的隔离机制。

items.reason_en: TLS async decryption failure handling causes resource leaks and potential denial of service in cloud-hosted encrypted traffic processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: TLS 异步解密失败处理不当会导致资源泄漏及潜在的拒绝服务，影响托管于云端的加密流量处理流水线。

items.reason_en: IPVS FTP helper unregister race during namespace cleanup leads to use-after-free, endangering containerized network load balancers and microservice routing.
items.reason_zh: 命名空间清理期间 IPVS FTP 辅助程序注销竞态条件导致释放后使用漏洞，危及容器化网络负载均衡器与微服务路由。

items.reason_en: Resolves invalid union member access in the Ceph messenger layer, preventing potential kernel memory corruption or privilege escalation within distributed cloud storage clusters.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 Ceph 消息层中无效的联合体成员访问问题，防止分布式云存储集群内潜在的内存损坏或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Implements mandatory cache line eviction during SNP memory validation, closing a critical hardware-assisted virtualization flaw that could leak confidential tenant data from secure enclaves.
items.reason_zh: 在 SNP 内存验证期间实施强制缓存行驱逐，修复了可能导致机密租户数据从安全飞地泄露的关键硬件辅助虚拟化漏洞。

items.reason_en: Blocks intra-host migration of SEV-encrypted VMs during active vCPU creation, preventing state inconsistency and potential security bypasses in cloud hypervisor environments.
items.reason_zh: 阻止活跃 vCPU 创建期间的 SEV 加密虚拟机主机内迁移，防止云虚拟化环境中的状态不一致及潜在的安全绕过。

items.reason_en: KVM SVM fails to forcibly exit SMM mode on shutdown, potentially allowing nested VM escape or hypervisor state corruption.
items.reason_zh: KVM SVM 在关机时未能强制退出 SMM 模式，可能导致嵌套虚拟机逃逸或虚拟化层状态损坏。

items.reason_en: KVM x86 IRTE misconfiguration prevents proper IRQ posting to vCPUs, degrading virtualized workload performance and stability.
items.reason_zh: KVM x86 IRTE 配置错误导致无法正确向虚拟 CPU 投递中断请求，降低虚拟化工作负载的性能与稳定性。

items.reason_en: IOMMU VT-d context entry setup order regression breaks static identity domain attachment for aliased devices, risking DMA isolation failures.
items.reason_zh: IOMMU VT-d 上下文条目设置顺序回退破坏了别名设备的静态标识域绑定，存在 DMA 隔离失效风险。

items.reason_en: Missing SRCU lock in KVM_GET_MP_STATE exposes guest memory to race conditions during APIC event processing, threatening tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: KVM_GET_MP_STATE 缺少 SRCU 锁导致在处理 APIC 事件期间客户机内存面临竞态条件，威胁租户隔离性。

items.reason_en: Fixes IPv6 SNAT socket lookup failures in netfilter that break connection tracking, preventing packet spoofing and state confusion in cloud networking layers.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 netfilter 中导致连接跟踪失效的 IPv6 SNAT 套接字查找失败问题，防止云网络层出现数据包伪造与状态混淆。

items.reason_en: Disables broken Intel PT virtualization support in KVM VMX, eliminating hypervisor crashes caused by unstable guest/host profiling modes.
items.reason_zh: 禁用了 KVM VMX 中损坏的 Intel PT 虚拟化支持，消除了因不稳定的客户机/主机分析模式导致的虚拟化层崩溃。

items.reason_en: Corrects suspicious RCU usage in VT-D IOMMU fault handling, ensuring stable interrupt processing and preventing kernel panics in virtualized cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 VT-D IOMMU 故障处理中可疑的 RCU 用法，确保中断处理稳定并防止虚拟化云环境中的内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: Incorrect ASCE index handling in KVM s390 virtualization can break guest isolation, enabling potential VM escapes or denial of service on cloud hosts.
items.reason_zh: KVM s390 虚拟化中错误的 ASCE 索引处理可能破坏客户机隔离，导致云主机上潜在的虚拟机逃逸或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free bug in the Ceph filesystem during capability trimming threatens data integrity and availability in cloud storage clusters.
items.reason_zh: Ceph 文件系统在能力修剪期间存在的释放后使用漏洞威胁云存储集群的数据完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Flawed subrequest joining logic in NFS can cause silent data corruption, jeopardizing consistency in distributed cloud storage and computing environments.
items.reason_zh: NFS 中缺陷的子请求合并逻辑可能导致静默数据损坏，危及分布式云存储与计算环境的一致性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in NVMe target request completion enables privilege escalation in cloud storage fabric deployments.
items.reason_zh: NVMe 目标请求完成过程中的释放后使用漏洞可在云存储架构部署中导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during passive socket shutdown in MPTCP impacts multipath TCP load balancers in cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: MPTCP在被动套接字关闭期间存在释放后使用漏洞，影响云环境中的多路径TCP负载均衡器。

items.reason_en: Improper queue pair destroy timing in RDMA/siw leads to UAF, threatening RDMA-based cloud interconnects.
items.reason_zh: RDMA/siw中队列对销毁时机不当会导致释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，威胁基于RDMA的云互连架构。

items.reason_en: Ivanti Connect Secure mishandles DSCache configuration trust, leading to privilege escalation to root. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild, posing an immediate threat to enterprise identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Ivanti Connect Secure错误处理DSCache配置信任关系，导致提权至root。该漏洞已在真实环境中被积极利用，对企业身份基础设施构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: Nutanix Prism Element allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication by injecting a crafted internal HTTP header, granting full administrative API access.
items.reason_zh: Nutanix Prism Element允许未认证的远程攻击者通过注入构造的内部HTTP头绕过身份验证，从而获取完整的API管理权限。

items.reason_en: OpenShift console endpoints expose devfile APIs without authentication, enabling unauthenticated attackers to trigger Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) against internal cluster services.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift控制台端点以未认证方式暴露devfile API，使未认证攻击者能够对内部集群服务触发服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）。

items.reason_en: Google gVisor's VFS implementation contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a local container attacker to escalate privileges and achieve code execution in the host sentry process.
items.reason_zh: Google gVisor的VFS实现中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许本地容器攻击者提权并在主机sentry进程中实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Diagnostic logs on Azure deployments may record security-sensitive authentication data in cleartext, risking credential theft by attackers with log access.
items.reason_zh: Azure部署的诊断日志可能以明文形式记录安全敏感的认证数据，存在被拥有日志访问权限的攻击者窃取凭证的风险。

items.reason_en: Default cleartext transport for Amazon S3 connections in MarkLogic Server exposes transmitted data and credentials to network interception.
items.reason_zh: MarkLogic Server中Amazon S3连接的默认明文传输协议会使传输的数据和凭证面临网络窃听风险。

items.reason_en: Critical authorization flaw in Azure Kubernetes Service allows unauthorized privilege escalation, directly compromising containerized workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Service中存在关键授权缺陷，允许未授权提权，直接危及容器化工作负载的安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthorized privilege escalation in Azure AI Foundry threatens model deployment integrity and associated training data.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry中的未授权提权漏洞威胁模型部署完整性及相关训练数据的安全。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Entra ID Entitlement Management facilitates spoofing attacks, undermining enterprise identity governance and access controls.
items.reason_zh: Entra ID Entitlement Management中的SSRF漏洞助长了欺骗攻击，破坏了企业身份治理与访问控制机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Hyper-V enables local code execution, significantly increasing hypervisor escape risks.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地代码执行，显著增加虚拟机监控程序逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Critical SSRF vulnerability in Azure Databricks allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges and access internal cloud resources over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Databricks中存在关键SSRF漏洞，允许未认证攻击者提升权限并通过网络访问内部云资源。

items.reason_en: Jinja2 template injection in Ansible Operator plugins lets low-privileged Kubernetes users execute arbitrary commands by crafting malicious custom resources.
items.reason_zh: Ansible Operator插件中的Jinja2模板注入漏洞允许低权限Kubernetes用户通过构造恶意自定义资源执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in the Azure Monitor Agent enables local privilege escalation for authenticated users monitoring cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure Monitor Agent中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可使已认证用户实现本地提权，用于监控云工作负载。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in Azure Arc allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally, threatening hybrid cloud management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc的身份验证机制不当，允许已认证攻击者在本地提权，威胁混合云管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: OpenShift console SSRF via Helm chart URLs allows authenticated users to probe and interact with internal cluster services.
items.reason_zh: 通过Helm Chart URL触发的OpenShift控制台SSRF漏洞，允许已认证用户探测并与内部集群服务交互。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Red Hat DPDK vhost handler can compromise host virtualization layers and cause denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat DPDK vhost处理器中的释放后使用漏洞可破坏主机虚拟化层并导致拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Rancher project naming collision grants cross-cluster resource access, violating multi-tenant isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Rancher项目命名冲突可导致跨集群资源访问，违反多租户隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Flawed SAML identity linking in Sentry allows account takeover via malicious identity providers without user consent.
items.reason_zh: Sentry中SAML身份链接机制存在缺陷，允许通过恶意身份提供商在未经用户同意的情况下接管账户。

items.reason_en: Renovate preset manipulation allows attackers to override critical environment variables like PATH and LD_PRELOAD, risking CI/CD compromise.
items.reason_zh: 操纵Renovate预设可使攻击者覆盖PATH和LD_PRELOAD等关键环境变量，导致CI/CD流水线面临被入侵风险。

items.reason_en: Improper link resolution in QNAP Virtualization Station enables path traversal attacks that threaten underlying host security.
items.reason_zh: QNAP Virtualization Station中链接解析不当可导致目录遍历攻击，威胁底层主机安全。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated API request flooding in OpenShift Lightspeed exhausts monitoring resources and degrades cloud observability.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift Lightspeed中未认证的API请求泛洪会耗尽监控资源，降低云可观测性。

items.reason_en: Critical use-after-free in the Ceph metadata client during session operations can destabilize distributed storage clusters and enable privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Ceph元数据客户端在会话操作期间存在关键释放后使用漏洞，可能导致分布式存储集群不稳定并引发提权。

items.reason_en: Race condition between LPI release and re-registration in ARM virtualization can cause guest VM crashes or hypervisor instability.
items.reason_zh: ARM虚拟化中LPI释放与重新注册之间的竞态条件可导致客户机VM崩溃或虚拟机监控程序不稳定。

items.reason_en: Unbounded backend response indexing allows malicious VMs to write outside allocated arrays, breaking Xen isolation guarantees.
items.reason_zh: 无界后端响应索引机制允许恶意VM写入分配数组之外的内存，破坏Xen的隔离保证。

items.reason_en: Known exploited OS command injection in the backup replication receiver enables full system compromise, posing severe data loss and ransomware propagation risks.
items.reason_zh: 备份复制接收器中存在已知被利用的操作系统命令注入漏洞，可导致系统完全沦陷，带来严重的数据丢失和勒索软件传播风险。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited file write vulnerability in the email security gateway allows attackers to drop arbitrary payloads on the underlying OS, bypassing cloud-based mail defenses.
items.reason_zh: 邮件安全网关中存在被积极利用的文件写入漏洞，允许攻击者在底层操作系统上投放任意载荷，从而绕过基于云的邮件防御。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication step in the hosted login handler allows unauthenticated actors to hijack account usernames before multi-factor verification, undermining identity-as-a-service architectures.
items.reason_zh: 托管登录处理器中缺失身份验证步骤，允许未认证攻击者在多因素验证前劫持账户用户名，破坏身份即服务（IDaaS）架构。

items.reason_en: KVM shadow paging UAF due to unexpected GFN modifications allows guest VMs to escape isolation and compromise host memory.
items.reason_zh: 由于意外的GFN修改导致的KVM影子页表释放后使用漏洞，允许客户机VM突破隔离并破坏主机内存。

items.reason_en: Deferred file lock UAF in ksmbd triggers crashes or privilege escalation when handling concurrent SMB2 cancel requests.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd中的延迟文件锁释放后使用漏洞在处理并发SMB2取消请求时会触发崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Btrfs tracepoint superblock mismatch under overlay filesystems causes kernel panics, directly impacting containerized cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: 覆盖文件系统下Btrfs跟踪点的超级块不匹配会导致内核崩溃，直接影响容器化云工作负载。

items.reason_en: KVM vCPU online verification flaw allows out-of-bounds memory access during index clamping, risking host compromise in virtualized cloud workloads.
items.reason_zh: KVM的vCPU在线验证缺陷允许在索引边界限制期间发生越界内存访问，危及虚拟化云工作负载的主机安全。

items.reason_en: Open vSwitch use-after-free during connection tracking exit allows SDN controllers and hypervisors to suffer denial-of-service or arbitrary code execution.
items.reason_zh: Open vSwitch在连接跟踪退出时的释放后使用漏洞可导致SDN控制器和虚拟机监控程序遭受拒绝服务或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: VFIO/PCI INTx handler flaw enables virtualized environments to bypass interrupt masking, risking VM escape or host-level instability.
items.reason_zh: VFIO/PCI INTx处理程序缺陷使虚拟化环境能够绕过中断屏蔽，存在虚拟机逃逸或导致主机级不稳定的风险。

items.reason_en: NFS direct write use-after-free compromises distributed storage systems, potentially leading to data corruption or kernel panic in cloud storage clusters.
items.reason_zh: NFS直接写入的释放后使用漏洞会破坏分布式存储系统，可能导致云存储集群中的数据损坏或内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Incorrect device mapper suspend/resume pairing causes list corruption and crashes, disrupting LVM and cloud infrastructure storage stacks.
items.reason_zh: 设备映射器挂起/恢复配对错误会导致列表损坏和崩溃，破坏LVM及云基础设施存储栈的运行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server enables unauthenticated network RCE, jeopardizing critical name resolution infrastructure and network reliability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未认证的网络远程代码执行，危及关键名称解析基础设施和网络可靠性。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Network Policy Server allows unauthenticated network RCE, compromising authentication gateways and access control enforcement.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行，破坏身份验证网关和访问控制执行机制。

items.reason_en: NDIS buffer length validation failure permits local privilege escalation via crafted applications, destabilizing network driver stacks and packet processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: NDIS缓冲区长度验证失败允许通过构造的应用程序实现本地权限提升，破坏网络驱动栈和数据包处理流水线的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Race condition deadlock in Windows RRAS enables unauthenticated network DoS, disrupting routing, remote access, and VPN connectivity services.
items.reason_zh: Windows RRAS中的竞态条件死锁可导致未认证的网络拒绝服务，破坏路由、远程访问和VPN连接服务。

items.reason_en: DHCP Server use-after-free allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute code, potentially disrupting or taking control of entire IP subnets.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server的释放后使用漏洞允许未认证的网络攻击者执行代码，可能破坏或接管整个IP子网。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in WebDAV enables privilege escalation when processing malicious network requests, affecting enterprise file sharing and synchronization infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV中的堆溢出漏洞在处理恶意网络请求时可导致权限提升，影响企业文件共享与同步基础设施。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Protocol use-after-free vulnerability allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges locally, compromising remote access gateways.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Protocol的释放后使用漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在本地提升权限，从而破坏远程访问网关。

items.reason_en: Windows Media heap overflow permits network-based code execution, exploiting widely deployed multimedia processing pipelines across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media的堆溢出漏洞允许基于网络的代码执行，可被利用来破坏企业网络中广泛部署的多媒体处理流水线。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 out-of-bounds read in Server for NFS allows remote attackers to execute code, disrupting file sharing services across networks.
items.reason_zh: Server for NFS中存在CVSS 8.8的越界读取漏洞，允许远程攻击者执行代码，破坏跨网络的共享服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 double free in DHCP Server enables remote code execution, potentially allowing attackers to hijack IP address assignments.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server中存在CVSS 8.1的双重释放漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，攻击者可能借此劫持IP地址分配。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 remote code execution in RRAS directly compromises routing infrastructure, enabling traffic interception or network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: RRAS中存在CVSS 8.8的远程代码执行漏洞，直接破坏路由基础设施，使攻击者能够实施流量拦截或网络跳板攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 race condition in Deployment Services allows remote attackers to execute code during OS installation processes.
items.reason_zh: Deployment Services中存在CVSS 8.1的竞态条件漏洞，允许远程攻击者在操作系统安装过程中执行代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 use-after-free in DHCP Client permits remote code execution on adjacent networks, facilitating lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Client中存在CVSS 8.8的释放后使用漏洞，允许在相邻网络上执行远程代码，便于攻击者进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server service enables unauthorized network RCE. Compromising DNS infrastructure can disrupt network resolution, facilitate cache poisoning, and enable broader lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server服务中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致未授权的网络远程代码执行。破坏DNS基础设施将干扰网络解析、助长缓存投毒，并支持更广泛的横向移动。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows SMB Client allows unauthorized network privilege escalation. SMB is frequently leveraged for lateral movement and ransomware propagation across corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Client中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权的网络权限提升。SMB常被用于在企业网络中进行横向移动和勒索软件传播。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in AD FS enables network spoofing attacks, undermining federated identity verification across organizational boundaries.
items.reason_zh: AD FS中的弱认证问题可导致网络欺骗攻击，削弱跨组织边界的联合身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows iSCSI initiator allows remote denial of service, disrupting storage area network connectivity and availability.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI initiator中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务，破坏存储区域网络的连接性与可用性。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in RRAS enables remote code execution over the network, severely impacting routing infrastructure and remote access services.
items.reason_zh: RRAS中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，严重影响路由基础设施和远程访问服务。

items.reason_en: Exploitable integer underflow in PPP EAP-TLS allows remote code execution, compromising secure network authentication and remote access protocols.
items.reason_zh: PPP EAP-TLS中可利用的整数下溢漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏安全网络认证和远程访问协议。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in the Network Policy Server permits remote code execution, threatening network access control and policy enforcement services.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server中的整数下溢漏洞允许远程代码执行，威胁网络访问控制和政策执行服务。

items.reason_en: A double free vulnerability in the Remote Desktop Gateway Service allows remote code execution, jeopardizing secure remote desktop connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，危及安全的远程桌面连接。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution, disrupting IP address management and core network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server中的竞态条件漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏IP地址管理和核心网络连接。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the DNS Server allows remote code execution, potentially hijacking DNS resolution and redirecting internal traffic to malicious endpoints.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server中的释放后使用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，可能劫持DNS解析并将内部流量重定向至恶意端点。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in SMB Server facilitates denial-of-service attacks, crippling file sharing, printer services, and domain controller communication.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server中的资源耗尽漏洞可导致拒绝服务攻击，严重破坏文件共享、打印机服务及域控制器通信。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the TCP/IP stack enables remote code execution, destabilizing fundamental network communications and routing protocols.
items.reason_zh: TCP/IP协议栈中的释放后使用漏洞可启用远程代码执行，破坏基础网络通信与路由协议的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the RDP Client allows attackers to compromise workstation sessions, serving as a primary vector for lateral movement in enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: RDP客户端的远程代码执行漏洞可使攻击者劫持工作站会话，成为企业网络中横向移动的主要途径。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the DHCP Server permits remote code execution, further exposing critical network infrastructure to exploitation and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: DHCP服务器的越界写入漏洞允许远程代码执行，进一步使关键网络基础设施面临被利用和服务中断的风险。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized MAC header offset in the QMI WWAN driver triggers kernel panics on ARM64, disrupting cellular modem functionality in routers and gateways.
items.reason_zh: QMI WWAN驱动中未初始化的MAC头偏移量会在ARM64架构上触发内核恐慌，导致路由器和网关中的蜂窝调制解调器功能中断。

items.reason_en: TCP fastopen race condition during listener close can cause crashes or denial of service, impacting high-throughput network appliances and proxy servers.
items.reason_zh: 监听器关闭期间的TCP FastOpen竞态条件可能导致系统崩溃或拒绝服务，影响高吞吐量网络设备及代理服务器。

items.reason_en: Malformed DFS referral responses from malicious SMB servers cause out-of-bounds reads, compromising network file sharing security and enabling information leakage.
items.reason_zh: 恶意SMB服务器返回的畸形DFS重定向响应会导致越界读取，破坏网络文件共享安全性并引发信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Non-constant-time MAC comparison in SCTP enables timing side-channel attacks, weakening cryptographic integrity checks in enterprise network protocols.
items.reason_zh: SCTP中非恒定时间的MAC比较会引发时序侧信道攻击，削弱企业网络协议中的密码学完整性校验。

items.reason_en: Introduces boundary validation for virtual function parameters sent to Intel i40e NICs, preventing out-of-bounds hardware context writes and potential network controller exploitation.
items.reason_zh: 为发送至Intel i40e网卡的虚拟函数参数引入边界验证，防止越界硬件上下文写入及潜在的网络控制器被利用。

items.reason_en: Rejects HSR protocol frames lacking sufficient space for tags, stopping kernel crashes and denial-of-service attacks targeting enterprise and industrial network switches.
items.reason_zh: 拒绝接收缺乏足够标签空间的HSR协议帧，阻止针对企业和工业网络交换机的内核崩溃及拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Mitigates A-MSDU spoofing attacks in IEEE 802.11 mesh networks by enforcing strict frame validation, addressing a critical gap from earlier wireless framework disclosures.
items.reason_zh: 通过强制实施严格的帧验证缓解IEEE 802.11网状网络中的A-MSDU欺骗攻击，弥补了早期无线框架披露中存在的关键缺陷。

items.reason_en: Fixes missing bounds checking during ksmbd mount parsing, preventing slab corruption and potential remote code execution via maliciously crafted SMB share requests.
items.reason_zh: 修复ksmbd挂载解析过程中缺失的边界检查，防止slab损坏及通过恶意构造的SMB共享请求导致的潜在远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Remotely triggerable RPC server crash via specially crafted packets allows attackers to cause denial of service without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 通过特制数据包可远程触发RPC服务器崩溃，使攻击者无需认证即可造成拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in ksmbd Kerberos authentication carries a high EPSS score, enabling potential privilege escalation or unauthorized file share access.
items.reason_zh: ksmbd Kerberos认证中的释放后使用漏洞具有较高的EPSS评分，可能导致权限提升或未经授权的文件共享访问。

items.reason_en: Open vSwitch MPLS parsing dead loop triggers soft lockups and CPU exhaustion when processing malformed or deeply nested label stacks.
items.reason_zh: Open vSwitch在处理畸形或深度嵌套的标签栈时，其MPLS解析死循环会触发软锁死和CPU资源耗尽。

items.reason_en: BPF peer redirection fails to scrub packet metadata, allowing sensitive network namespace information to leak across security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: BPF对等体重定向未能清除数据包元数据，导致敏感的网络命名空间信息跨越安全边界泄露。

items.reason_en: Validates untrusted remote fields in SMC proposal messages, preventing buffer manipulation attacks on high-speed network interconnects.
items.reason_zh: 验证SMC提议消息中的不可信远程字段，防止对高速网络互连的缓冲区操纵攻击。

items.reason_en: Resolves scheduling-while-atomic bugs during parallel MPTCP subflow creation, maintaining reliable multi-path TCP performance under heavy load.
items.reason_zh: 解决并行创建MPTCP子流时的原子调度错误，确保在高负载下维持可靠的多路径TCP性能。

items.reason_en: Separates async and synchronous TLS decryption request handling to prevent race conditions that could corrupt encryption state and drop secure traffic.
items.reason_zh: 分离异步与同步TLS解密请求的处理流程，防止可能破坏加密状态并丢弃安全流量的竞态条件。

items.reason_en: Unprotected link service additions in the SMC stack trigger kernel panics, disrupting high-throughput data center networking fabrics.
items.reason_zh: SMC协议栈中未受保护的链路服务添加操作会触发内核恐慌，破坏高吞吐量数据中心网络拓扑结构。

items.reason_en: Invalid buffer access in MLX5E XSK paths causes driver crashes during packet offloading, degrading performance and reliability of enterprise network adapters.
items.reason_zh: MLX5E XSK路径中的无效缓冲区访问会在数据包卸载期间导致驱动程序崩溃，降低企业网络适配器的性能与可靠性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds access during IPv6 TLV parsing allows remote attackers to crash network stacks or leak sensitive kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 TLV解析过程中的越界访问允许远程攻击者使网络协议栈崩溃或泄露敏感的内核内存。

items.reason_en: Misinterpreting corrupted firmware channel counts in Intel WiFi drivers leads to memory corruption, compromising wireless infrastructure security.
items.reason_zh: Intel WiFi驱动中误解析固件损坏的信道数量会导致内存损坏，危及无线基础设施的安全性。

items.reason_en: MTU negotiation flaw allows malicious peers to force invalid configurations, disrupting TIPC network stability.
items.reason_zh: MTU协商缺陷允许恶意对等方强制设置无效配置，破坏TIPC网络的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Ignoring genmask during nf_tables chain ID lookup causes firewall rule bypasses and policy enforcement failures.
items.reason_zh: 在nf_tables链ID查找过程中忽略genmask会导致防火墙规则绕过及策略执行失败。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free during inter-server NFS copy crashes network file sharing appliances and disrupts data replication.
items.reason_zh: 跨服务器NFS复制过程中的释放后使用漏洞会导致网络文件共享设备崩溃并中断数据复制。

items.reason_en: A publicly disclosed heap-based buffer overflow in Wavlink router firmware allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via the api.cgi endpoint.
items.reason_zh: Wavlink路由器固件中公开披露的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经认证的远程攻击者通过api.cgi端点执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Netgate pfSense CE contains an OS command injection vulnerability in Traffic Shaper Limiters, allowing authenticated users with limited privileges to execute root commands.
items.reason_zh: Netgate pfSense CE的Traffic Shaper Limiters中存在OS命令注入漏洞，允许具有有限权限的已认证用户执行root命令。

items.reason_en: QNAP QuRouter suffers from a TOCTOU race condition that can compromise system security, potentially allowing unauthorized network configuration changes or privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: QNAP QuRouter存在TOCTOU竞态条件漏洞，可能危及系统安全，导致未经授权的网络配置更改或权限提升。

items.reason_en: NGINX SSL session cache without explicit ticket key rotation allows remote attackers to forge client sessions, bypassing authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: NGINX SSL会话缓存若未显式轮换票据密钥，将允许远程攻击者伪造客户端会话，从而绕过身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass in F5 NGINX Kubernetes Ingress Controller via manipulated routing headers grants unauthenticated access to protected application paths.
items.reason_zh: 通过篡改路由头，F5 NGINX Kubernetes Ingress Controller 中的授权绕过漏洞可导致攻击者获取对受保护应用路径的未认证访问权限。

items.reason_en: Mishandled OAuth IdP responses in NGINX Ingress Controller allow attackers to acquire unauthenticated access before external authentication completes.
items.reason_zh: NGINX Ingress Controller 中错误处理 OAuth IdP 响应，使攻击者能在外部认证完成前获取未认证访问权限。

items.reason_en: A short heap overread during RSA key exchange in GnuTLS can disclose sensitive cryptographic material or crash secure TLS connections.
items.reason_zh: GnuTLS 在 RSA 密钥交换期间发生短堆越界读取，可能导致敏感加密材料泄露或安全 TLS 连接崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unbounded RPC statistics tracking in rpcbind allows remote unauthenticated attackers to exhaust system memory and trigger a denial of service.
items.reason_zh: rpcbind 中无限制的 RPC 统计跟踪功能允许远程未认证攻击者耗尽系统内存并触发拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in Red Hat's libsoup WebSocket implementation can be triggered by large outgoing payloads, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat libsoup 的 WebSocket 实现中存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过大型出站载荷触发，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited double free in Windows IKE Extension enables remote code execution, severely impacting VPN and network connectivity security.
items.reason_zh: Windows IKE 扩展中被主动利用的双重释放漏洞可启用远程代码执行，严重威胁 VPN 和网络连接的安全性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows remote code execution, destabilizing core network protocols.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的竞争条件漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏核心网络协议的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Authorization vulnerability in Kerberos enables adjacent network privilege escalation, threatening enterprise authentication infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Kerberos 中的授权漏洞可实现相邻网络权限提升，威胁企业认证基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in UPnP Device Host allows local privilege escalation, exposing network-facing consumer devices.
items.reason_zh: UPnP Device Host 中的不信任指针解引用漏洞可导致本地权限提升，使面向网络的消费级设备面临风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in OPNsense GeoIP importer allows attackers to write arbitrary files below restricted directories, potentially leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: OPNsense GeoIP 导入器中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者在受限目录下方写入任意文件，可能导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the pfSense FRR status filter enables authenticated WebGUI users to execute arbitrary system commands.
items.reason_zh: pfSense FRR 状态过滤器中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许已认证的 WebGUI 用户执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Carriage-return injection in OPNsense login fields bypasses syslog lockout mechanisms, facilitating brute-force attacks against firewall administration.
items.reason_zh: OPNsense 登录字段中的回车符注入漏洞可绕过 syslog 锁定机制，便于针对防火墙管理的暴力破解攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in Windows Active Directory permits authenticated attackers to execute code over an adjacent network, disrupting directory services.
items.reason_zh: Windows Active Directory 中输入验证不当的漏洞允许已认证攻击者在相邻网络上执行代码，从而破坏目录服务。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in TRENDnet web management interface enables complete device compromise without authentication.
items.reason_zh: TRENDnet Web 管理界面中的远程命令注入漏洞可在无需认证的情况下导致设备被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Linksys router firmware allows remote code execution triggered via MAC filter parameters.
items.reason_zh: Linksys 路由器固件中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过 MAC 过滤参数触发，导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical command injection via D-Link HNAP handler bypasses authentication and grants root shell access to the device.
items.reason_zh: 通过 D-Link HNAP 处理器触发的关键命令注入漏洞可绕过认证机制，为攻击者提供设备的 root shell 访问权限。

items.reason_en: OPNsense Trust module interpolates attacker-controlled values into XPath expressions, enabling injection attacks on firewall rules.
items.reason_zh: OPNsense Trust 模块将攻击者控制的值拼接到 XPath 表达式中，导致针对防火墙规则的注入攻击。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited unauthenticated command injection in Progress ADC LoadMaster appliances allows full device takeover.
items.reason_zh: Progress ADC LoadMaster 设备中被主动利用的未认证命令注入漏洞可导致设备被完全接管。

items.reason_en: Bootzd zero-touch provisioning daemon in Juniper Junos OS Evolved accepts crafted DHCP responses to execute commands as root.
items.reason_zh: Juniper Junos OS Evolved 中的 Bootzd 零接触配置守护进程会接受构造的 DHCP 响应，并以 root 权限执行命令。

items.reason_en: Format string vulnerability in Juniper ipfd daemon enables remote unauthenticated code execution with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: Juniper ipfd 守护进程中的格式化字符串漏洞可导致远程未认证攻击者以 root 权限执行代码。

items.reason_en: Use-After-Free in F5 NGINX async I/O processing triggered by Server Side Includes can lead to worker process compromise.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX 异步 I/O 处理中由服务器端包含（SSI）触发的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可导致工作进程被控制。

items.reason_en: High-severity race condition in packet backlog handling causes slab-use-after-free, enabling remote denial-of-service or code execution via crafted traffic.
items.reason_zh: 数据包积压处理中的高危竞争条件会导致 slab 释放后使用漏洞，攻击者可通过构造流量实现远程拒绝服务或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unsigned integer underflow in bridge VLAN untagging can corrupt flow table state, bypassing firewall rules and causing network instability.
items.reason_zh: 网桥 VLAN 去标签化过程中的无符号整数下溢漏洞可能损坏流表状态，导致防火墙规则被绕过及网络不稳定。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the MediaTek Wi-Fi driver leads to use-after-free during packet polling, exploitable for local privilege escalation or DoS.
items.reason_zh: MediaTek Wi-Fi 驱动中的竞争条件会在轮询数据包时引发释放后使用漏洞，可被用于本地权限提升或拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Known exploited RCE in the firewall management interface allows authenticated network attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges, directly compromising perimeter security.
items.reason_zh: 防火墙管理界面中已知被利用的远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞允许已认证的网络攻击者以 root 权限执行任意代码，直接破坏边界安全。

items.reason_en: Syntactic validation flaw in the VPN daemon permits complete device takeover by authenticated attackers leveraging AutoDiscovery VPN message processing.
items.reason_zh: VPN 守护进程中的语法验证缺陷允许已认证攻击者利用 AutoDiscovery VPN 消息处理过程完全接管设备。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the J-Web management component allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary Junos commands with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: J-Web 管理组件中的认证绕过漏洞允许未认证远程攻击者以 root 权限执行任意 Junos 命令。

items.reason_en: Highly exploitable race condition in SSH signal handling creates a regression that can lead to privilege escalation or service disruption across millions of managed endpoints.
items.reason_zh: SSH 信号处理中极易利用的竞争条件引入了回归缺陷，可能导致数百万个受管终端出现权限提升或服务中断。

items.reason_en: IPv6 SIT tunnel GSO offloading caches stale inner headers, enabling remote packet corruption and potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 SIT 隧道 GSO 卸载机制缓存了过期的内部报文头，可导致远程报文损坏及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect wildcard tunnel matching in ip6_vti allows attackers to bypass firewall rules or redirect traffic at the network layer.
items.reason_zh: ip6_vti 中错误的通配符隧道匹配漏洞允许攻击者在网络层绕过防火墙规则或重定向流量。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in ICMPv6 reception can be triggered remotely to execute arbitrary code on routers and network appliances.
items.reason_zh: ICMPv6 接收处理中的释放后使用漏洞可被远程触发，从而在路由器和网络设备上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Recompression of IPv6 RPL Source Routing Headers lacks headroom validation, causing buffer overflows in routing stacks.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 RPL 源路由报头的重新压缩缺乏头部预留空间验证，会导致路由栈发生缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited buffer overflow in Palo Alto PAN-OS Captive Portal allows unauthenticated root RCE, directly compromising perimeter security and network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Palo Alto PAN-OS 认证门户中存在正被积极利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致未授权获取 root 权限并实现远程代码执行，直接危及边界安全与网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Linux ksmbd out-of-bounds write in EA alignment processing enables remote code execution via malicious SMB clients targeting network file shares.
items.reason_zh: Linux ksmbd 在处理扩展属性（EA）对齐时存在越界写入漏洞，攻击者可通过针对网络文件共享的恶意 SMB 客户端实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Linux netfilter IPv6 EUI-64 module fails to validate source MAC headers, allowing attackers to craft packets that bypass traffic filtering and inspection rules.
items.reason_zh: Linux netfilter IPv6 EUI-64 模块未对源 MAC 地址报头进行验证，致使攻击者可构造报文以绕过流量过滤与检测规则。

items.reason_en: Linux SMC stack NULL pointer dereference and use-after-free in the TCP SYN path can crash network interfaces or facilitate privilege escalation in high-performance fabric deployments.
items.reason_zh: Linux SMC 协议栈在 TCP SYN 处理路径中存在空指针解引用及释放后使用漏洞，可导致网络接口崩溃或在高性能 Fabric 部署中引发权限提升。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Palo Alto GlobalProtect allows unauthenticated VPN tunnel establishment, actively exploited to bypass perimeter defenses.
items.reason_zh: Palo Alto GlobalProtect 存在身份验证绕过漏洞，允许在未认证的情况下建立 VPN 隧道，该漏洞正被积极利用以突破边界防御。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in FortiOS/FortiProxy enables unauthenticated remote code execution, currently tracked in CISA KEV due to widespread exploitation.
items.reason_zh: FortiOS/FortiProxy 存在密码学签名验证缺陷，可导致未授权的远程代码执行；因遭广泛利用，该漏洞现已被列入 CISA KEV 目录。

items.reason_en: Similar crypto bypass in FortiWeb compromises SAML-based SSO authentication, posing severe risks to enterprise web application firewalls.
items.reason_zh: FortiWeb 中存在类似的密码学绕过漏洞，可破坏基于 SAML 的单点登录（SSO）认证，对企业 Web 应用防火墙（WAF）构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: TLS queue handling bug in the Linux kernel can cause packet injection or denial-of-service when processing encrypted network traffic.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核中存在 TLS 队列处理缺陷，在处理加密网络流量时可能导致数据包注入或拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Scheduler qdisc replacement flaw allows local privilege escalation via crafted network configuration commands targeting Linux routing stacks.
items.reason_zh: 调度器 qdisc 替换机制存在缺陷，攻击者可通过针对 Linux 路由栈的伪造网络配置命令实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Mitigates a critical remote DoS vector in the SLIP interface where unvalidated packet sizes could trigger kernel crashes.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 SLIP 接口中存在的关键远程 DoS 攻击面，防止因未验证的数据包长度而触发内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Resolves a severe connection tracking bypass that allows attackers to evade firewall rules and potentially escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 修复了严重的连接跟踪绕过漏洞，防止攻击者规避防火墙规则并潜在地提升系统权限。

items.reason_en: Fixes a resource exhaustion flaw in the NFS server that leads to local denial of service under concurrent mount operations.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 NFS 服务器中的资源耗尽漏洞，该漏洞在并发挂载操作下会导致本地拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Addresses a crash caused by malformed SCTP packets, preventing remote attackers from destabilizing network stacks via protocol fuzzing.
items.reason_zh: 修复了由畸形 SCTP 报文引发的内核崩溃问题，阻止远程攻击者通过协议模糊测试破坏网络协议栈的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Corrects an out-of-bounds read in Wi-Fi driver statistics processing that could be leveraged for local privilege escalation or information leakage.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 Wi-Fi 驱动在处理统计信息时存在的越界读取漏洞，防止其被用于本地权限提升或敏感信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Closes a userspace-to-kernel injection flaw allowing malicious traffic scheduling configurations that compromise kernel stability.
items.reason_zh: 修复了从用户态向内核态注入恶意流量调度配置的漏洞，保障内核运行稳定性。

items.reason_en: UDP tunnel GRO forwarding mishandling can cause packet corruption and kernel panics, severely impacting network stack reliability and routing performance.
items.reason_zh: UDP 隧道 GRO 转发处理不当可能导致数据包损坏及内核恐慌，严重削弱网络协议栈的可靠性与路由性能。

items.reason_en: A race condition in IPv6 address management may trigger use-after-free bugs, compromising network namespace isolation and gateway stability.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 地址管理机制中存在竞态条件，可能触发释放后使用漏洞，进而破坏网络命名空间隔离性与网关稳定性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the GTP driver during link deletion exposes cellular network gateways to crashes or privilege escalation attacks.
items.reason_zh: GTP 驱动在删除链路时存在释放后使用漏洞，使蜂窝网络网关面临崩溃或被提权攻击的风险。

items.reason_en: Garbage collector racing against connect() can corrupt SCM_RIGHTS file descriptor passing, breaking inter-process security boundaries in networked applications.
items.reason_zh: 垃圾回收器与 connect() 调用之间的竞态条件可能破坏 SCM_RIGHTS 文件描述符传递机制，瓦解网络应用中的进程间安全边界。

items.reason_en: NVMe admin request queue lifetime fix prevents stale references after controller teardown, ensuring reliable operation of industrial storage arrays and PLC data logging.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 NVMe 管理请求队列的生命周期管理问题，防止控制器拆除后出现悬垂引用，确保工业存储阵列及 PLC 数据日志系统的稳定运行。

items.reason_en: MLX5 IRQ glue cleanup prevents crashes during interrupt allocation failures, maintaining stability for high-performance industrial network interfaces and telemetry systems.
items.reason_zh: 清理了 MLX5 IRQ 相关冗余代码，防止在中断分配失败时发生崩溃，保障高性能工业网卡及遥测系统的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Ext4 mount option parsing hardening prevents buffer over-reads on corrupted superblocks, safeguarding legacy industrial file systems from unexpected kernel panics.
items.reason_zh: 强化了 Ext4 挂载选项的解析逻辑，防止在损坏的超级块上发生缓冲区越界读取，避免遗留工业文件系统遭遇非预期的内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: BPF ring buffer IRQ work synchronization fix prevents race conditions during buffer deallocation, critical for deterministic real-time control system monitoring.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 BPF 环形缓冲区 IRQ 工作同步机制，防止缓冲区释放时发生竞态条件，对确定性实时控制系统监控至关重要。

items.reason_en: Enforces strict single-request sequencing for IBM ISM devices, preventing race conditions that could disrupt reliable mainframe-to-peripheral communication in SCADA/ICS architectures.
items.reason_zh: 为 IBM ISM 设备强制实施严格的单请求串行化机制，防止竞态条件破坏 SCADA/ICS 架构中主机与外设间的可靠通信。

items.reason_en: Fixes a kernel crash triggered by unlinking uninitialized conntrack entries, ensuring firewall and deep packet inspection reliability in industrial network segmentation.
items.reason_zh: 修复了因注销未初始化的 conntrack 条目而触发的内核崩溃问题，保障工业网络分区中防火墙与深度包检测（DPI）的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Corrects XDP_REDIRECT DMA unmapping lengths in bnxt_en drivers, preventing IOMMU faults and packet loss in high-throughput industrial Ethernet controllers.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 bnxt_en 驱动中 XDP_REDIRECT 的 DMA 解映射长度计算错误，防止高吞吐工业以太网控制器出现 IOMMU 故障与丢包。

items.reason_en: Fixes an out-of-bounds write in snap7 PLC client buffers triggered by malicious S7 peers, directly mitigating buffer overflow attacks on industrial controllers.
items.reason_zh: 修复了由恶意 S7 节点触发的 snap7 PLC 客户端缓冲区越界写入漏洞，直接阻断针对工业控制器的缓冲区溢出攻击。

items.reason_en: Closes an integer wraparound vulnerability in Handle_0x38_RequestFileTransfer that bypasses path length checks, securing firmware update mechanisms in automotive and industrial systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 Handle_0x38_RequestFileTransfer 函数中的整数回绕漏洞，防止其绕过路径长度校验，保障了汽车与工业系统的固件更新机制安全。

items.reason_en: Sanitizes PHY state switch operations in mpi3mr SCSI drivers to prevent configuration page corruption, ensuring storage backend reliability in industrial servers.
items.reason_zh: 修复 mpi3mr SCSI 驱动中的 PHY 状态切换操作，防止配置页损坏，确保工业服务器存储后端的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Race condition during I/O abort timeout causes storage controller crashes, risking OT data integrity and availability.
items.reason_zh: I/O 中止超时期间存在竞态条件，会导致存储控制器崩溃，危及 OT 数据的完整性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Stale SRB access around timeouts leads to crashes in Fibre Channel storage arrays used in industrial environments.
items.reason_zh: 超时前后访问失效的 SRB 会导致工业环境中的光纤通道存储阵列崩溃。

items.reason_en: Incorrect read-only state propagation can cause unintended writes to industrial flash media and block devices.
items.reason_zh: 只读状态传播错误可能导致意外写入工业闪存介质及块设备。

items.reason_en: Rockwell Automation ArmorBlock I/O devices allow unauthenticated attackers to change the webserver password, leading to admin account takeover and unauthorized configuration modifications.
items.reason_zh: Rockwell Automation ArmorBlock I/O 设备允许未授权攻击者更改 Web 服务器密码，进而导致管理员账户被接管及配置遭非法修改。

items.reason_en: NASA F Prime framework's FileUplink component uses wrapping U32 arithmetic for offset/size validation, enabling crafted packets to cause memory corruption or denial of service in embedded spaceflight systems.
items.reason_zh: NASA F Prime 框架的 FileUplink 组件在验证偏移量/大小时使用了回绕的 U32 算术运算，攻击者可利用构造的数据包在嵌入式航天系统中引发内存损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: The Linux kernel CAN J1939 module incorrectly handles session deactivation ref-counts under concurrent scenarios, risking kernel warnings and potential instability in automotive and industrial networks.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 CAN J1939 模块在并发场景下未能正确处理会话停用的引用计数，可能引发内核警告，并导致汽车与工业网络出现潜在的不稳定问题。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Unitronics UniStream Pro/UniLogic PLC firmware allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands on industrial controllers.
items.reason_zh: Unitronics UniStream Pro/UniLogic PLC 固件中存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可使远程攻击者在工业控制器上执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Memory buffer bounds violation in Unitronics PLC firmware can cause crashes or arbitrary code execution, disrupting critical industrial operations.
items.reason_zh: Unitronics PLC 固件中存在内存缓冲区越界访问漏洞，可引发系统崩溃或任意代码执行，从而中断关键工业运行。

items.reason_en: Authentication flaw in Unitronics UniLogic permits unauthorized configuration changes or access to industrial controller management interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Unitronics UniLogic 存在身份验证缺陷，可导致未授权修改配置或访问工业控制器管理界面。

items.reason_en: Format string vulnerability in Unitronics PLC firmware enables information disclosure or code execution through crafted log messages.
items.reason_zh: Unitronics PLC 固件中存在格式化字符串漏洞，攻击者可通过构造的日志消息实现信息泄露或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in HPE NonStop CIPSAM corrupts buffer data, risking system instability and potential exploitation in mission-critical environments.
items.reason_zh: HPE NonStop CIPSAM 存在越界写入漏洞，将损坏缓冲区数据，危及关键业务环境下的系统稳定性并增加被利用风险。

items.reason_en: Similar out-of-bounds write in QIOMON compromises memory integrity, threatening operational continuity in legacy industrial control systems.
items.reason_zh: QIOMON 中存在类似的越界写入漏洞，将破坏内存完整性，威胁遗留工业控制系统的业务连续性。

items.reason_en: Denial-of-service vulnerability in the finger daemon disrupts network utility services, impacting availability in specialized industrial networks.
items.reason_zh: finger 守护进程存在拒绝服务漏洞，将中断网络辅助服务，影响专用工业网络的可用性。

items.reason_en: Weak password recovery in Mitsubishi GENESIS SCADA/HMI systems allows unauthorized administrative access to critical processes.
items.reason_zh: Mitsubishi GENESIS SCADA/HMI 系统存在弱密码恢复机制缺陷，可导致未授权获取关键流程的管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Incorrect privilege assignment in Mitsubishi industrial suites enables low-privileged users to execute critical maintenance commands.
items.reason_zh: Mitsubishi 工业套件存在权限分配错误漏洞，致使低权限用户可执行关键维护命令。

items.reason_en: Insecure file uplink handling in NASA F Prime framework permits overwriting embedded software components with malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: NASA F Prime 框架的文件上行链路处理机制不安全，允许攻击者使用恶意载荷覆盖嵌入式软件组件。

items.reason_en: Insufficient packet length validation in SICK AG applications causes out-of-bounds reads and denial-of-service in operational environments.
items.reason_zh: SICK AG 应用程序缺乏充分的数据包长度验证，将在运行环境中引发越界读取及拒绝服务漏洞。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection in Slican WebCTI management interface compromises IP telephony and industrial communication systems.
items.reason_zh: Slican WebCTI 管理界面存在需认证的 SQL 注入漏洞，将危及 IP 语音及工业通信系统的安全。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in energy management software grants unauthorized administrative control, potentially disrupting operational technology environments and safety protocols.
items.reason_zh: 能源管理软件存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，可导致未授权获取管理控制权，进而破坏运营技术环境及安全协议。

items.reason_en: Unbounded IPMI event fetching allows misconfigured or malicious BMCs to cause denial-of-service conditions in industrial monitoring agents.
items.reason_zh: IPMI 事件获取缺乏边界限制，允许配置不当或恶意的 BMC 对工业监控代理发起拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Nozomi Networks Smart Polling lacks remote host certificate validation, enabling man-in-the-middle attacks against monitored OT/ICS devices and breaking encrypted telemetry channels.
items.reason_zh: Nozomi Networks Smart Polling 缺少远程主机证书验证机制，易受中间人攻击，导致受管 OT/ICS 设备及加密遥测通道被破坏。

items.reason_en: Insufficient privilege validation in the Nozomi Credentials Manager allows low-privileged users to extract sensitive operational credentials, risking unauthorized access to critical industrial systems.
items.reason_zh: Nozomi Credentials Manager 权限校验不严，致使低权限用户可窃取敏感操作凭证，进而导致关键工业系统面临未授权访问风险。

items.reason_en: Security control bypass in Quarkus REST Data Panache allows unauthenticated exploitation of generated microservice endpoints, undermining API-level authentication and authorization.
items.reason_zh: Quarkus REST Data Panache 存在安全控制绕过漏洞，攻击者无需认证即可利用生成的微服务端点，破坏了 API 层面的身份认证与授权机制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft QUIC enables unauthenticated network RCE, impacting modern HTTP/3 web transport layers and browser-to-server communications.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致无需认证的远程网络代码执行，严重影响现代 HTTP/3 传输层及浏览器与服务器的通信安全。

items.reason_en: Permissive CORS configuration in RESTEasy reflects Origin headers with credentials, facilitating malicious cross-site request forgery and sensitive data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy 的 CORS 配置过于宽松，会在携带凭据时反射 Origin 头，极易助长恶意 CSRF 攻击及敏感数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV allows authenticated network privilege escalation, compromising file synchronization and enterprise content sharing protocols.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 存在路径等价解析缺陷，可使已认证用户实现网络权限提升，危及文件同步与企业内容共享协议的安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authenticated network RCE, targeting enterprise content management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 存在反序列化漏洞，可导致需认证的远程网络代码执行，直接威胁企业内容管理与协作平台。

items.reason_en: Code injection in ASP.NET Core enables direct network-based RCE without authentication, critically compromising modern web application stacks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在代码注入漏洞，支持无需认证的远程网络代码执行，严重破坏现代 Web 应用架构的安全性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages, leading to session hijacking and potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，攻击者可向网页注入恶意脚本，进而导致会话劫持及潜在的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in .NET permits remote code execution over the network, destabilizing backend services and APIs relying on the framework.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的越界写入漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，导致依赖该框架的后端服务和 API 运行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Bypassing cryptographic signature verification in .NET undermines software integrity checks, enabling the execution of tampered or malicious payloads.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中绕过密码学签名验证会破坏软件完整性检查，从而允许执行被篡改或恶意的有效载荷。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.4 HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to bypass WAFs and perform cache poisoning or tampering.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中 CVSS 评分为 9.4 的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞允许攻击者绕过 WAF 并实施缓存投毒或篡改。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.3 cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables phishing attacks and session hijacking against webmail users.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 9.3 的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可针对网页邮件用户实施网络钓鱼攻击和会话劫持。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 absolute path traversal in Skype/Lync allows remote attackers to execute code by manipulating file paths in legacy communications platforms.
items.reason_zh: Skype/Lync 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的绝对路径遍历漏洞允许远程攻击者在传统通信平台中通过操纵文件路径来执行代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 server-side request forgery in SharePoint lets authenticated attackers pivot to internal services and elevate privileges.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中 CVSS 评分为 7.5 的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可使已认证的攻击者横向移动到内部服务并提升权限。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 stack-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server enables remote code execution via maliciously crafted web requests.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中 CVSS 评分为 8.1 的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意构造的 Web 请求实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint enables unauthenticated network spoofing, risking user credentials and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可导致未认证的网络安全欺骗，危及用户凭据并引发会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Bypasses access controls in SharePoint, allowing authenticated attackers to escalate privileges and access sensitive content.
items.reason_zh: 绕过 SharePoint 中的访问控制机制，使已认证的攻击者能够提升权限并访问敏感内容。

items.reason_en: Enables privilege escalation and data exfiltration by manipulating backend database queries within SharePoint environments.
items.reason_zh: 通过在 SharePoint 环境中操纵后端数据库查询，实现权限提升和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Allows attackers to bypass security appliances and manipulate request routing, compromising application integrity.
items.reason_zh: 允许攻击者绕过安全设备并操纵请求路由，破坏应用程序的完整性。

items.reason_en: Facilitates remote code execution through crafted web requests, threatening public-facing SharePoint deployments.
items.reason_zh: 通过精心构造的 Web 请求促成远程代码执行，对面向公网的 SharePoint 部署构成威胁。

items.reason_en: Enables attackers to perform server-side request forgery, potentially accessing internal network resources and escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: 使攻击者能够实施服务端请求伪造（SSRF），潜在地访问内部网络资源并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Allows privilege escalation over the network due to flawed authentication mechanisms in Microsoft Exchange Server.
items.reason_zh: 由于 Microsoft Exchange Server 中的身份验证机制存在缺陷，允许通过网络进行权限提升。

items.reason_en: Path equivalence resolution flaw in WebDAV allows remote attackers to execute code by manipulating file paths over standard HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的路径等价解析缺陷允许远程攻击者通过标准 HTTP/HTTPS 协议操纵文件路径来执行代码。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in SharePoint enables remote code execution, risking widespread compromise of enterprise document management systems.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致远程代码执行，使企业文档管理系统面临大规模沦陷风险。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Power Apps permits cross-origin attacks leading to remote code execution within the low-code development platform.
items.reason_zh: Power Apps 中的源验证错误允许跨域攻击，进而在该低代码开发平台内导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Gateway Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, jeopardizing secure remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许未认证的远程代码执行，危及安全远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft XML parsing enables remote code execution over the network, risking exploitation in web services and document processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft XML 解析中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许通过网络执行远程代码，在 Web 服务和文档处理流水线中存在被利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Internet Explorer allows local privilege escalation, maintaining relevance for legacy enterprise environments relying on older browser engines.
items.reason_zh: Internet Explorer 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可导致本地权限提升，在对旧版浏览器引擎仍有依赖的传统企业环境中仍具威胁。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in OpenSSH for Windows permits local privilege escalation, affecting secure shell implementations on Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞允许本地权限提升，影响 Windows 终端上的安全 Shell 实现。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in WebDAV allows local privilege escalation, impacting distributed file system access and cloud storage synchronization workflows.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响分布式文件系统访问及云存储同步工作流。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, undermining enterprise content management and collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，破坏企业内容管理与协作平台。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal flaw in Dynamics Business Central enables privilege escalation over the network, exposing critical ERP and business automation systems to unauthorized control.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central 中的目录遍历缺陷允许通过网络提升权限，使关键 ERP 和业务自动化系统暴露于未授权控制之下。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in SharePoint allows attackers to bypass security checks over the network, facilitating malicious code injection and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中不正确的密码学签名验证允许攻击者绕过网络安全检查，助长恶意代码注入与权限提升。

items.reason_en: Auth::check() fails open in ThinkCMF, allowing restricted backend administrators to execute arbitrary REST API calls and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: ThinkCMF 中 Auth::check() 函数存在默认放行（fail-open）缺陷，允许受限的后端管理员执行任意 REST API 调用并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Ships default administrator credentials for JuggleIM, granting unauthenticated attackers full control over tenant application consoles.
items.reason_zh: JuggleIM 附带默认的管理员凭据，授予未认证攻击者对租户应用控制台的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Exposes unauthenticated /api/* endpoints bound to 0.0.0.0, enabling attackers to inject commands into AI coding agents with elevated permissions.
items.reason_zh: 将未认证的 /api/* 端点绑定至 0.0.0.0 进行暴露，使攻击者能够以较高权限向 AI 编程代理注入命令。

items.reason_en: Race in sock_map_free compromises eBPF-based web proxy acceleration and modern load balancing architectures.
items.reason_zh: sock_map_free 函数中的竞态条件漏洞会影响基于 eBPF 的 Web 代理加速与现代负载均衡架构。

items.reason_en: 32-bit overflow in BPF array map element pointer calculation allows memory corruption in eBPF web filters.
items.reason_zh: BPF 数组映射元素指针计算中的 32 位整数溢出漏洞可导致 eBPF Web 过滤器发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Flex_bg fast_commit metadata corruption in ext4 risks web application database storage backend consistency.
items.reason_zh: ext4 文件系统的 flex_bg fast_commit 元数据损坏可能危及 Web 应用数据库存储后端的完整性。

items.reason_en: Atlassian Data Center products contain an arbitrary file access vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive files. This is currently listed in CISA KEV due to active exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Atlassian Data Center 产品存在任意文件访问漏洞，可使未授权攻击者读取敏感文件。因遭活跃利用，该漏洞目前已列入 CISA KEV 目录。

items.reason_en: EnergizeLab middleware allows registered low-privilege users to read arbitrary server files via controlled file paths, exposing middleware configurations and secrets.
items.reason_zh: EnergizeLab 中间件允许已注册的低权限用户通过构造文件路径读取任意服务器文件，导致中间件配置与密钥泄露。

items.reason_en: NetLicensing MCP Server interpolates caller-controlled product numbers directly into Python scripts, enabling unauthenticated command injection that compromises agentic licensing applications.
items.reason_zh: NetLicensing MCP Server 将调用方可控的产品编号直接拼接到 Python 脚本中，引发未授权命令注入漏洞，致使智能体许可应用受损。

items.reason_en: Tianji analytics platform passes user-controlled templates to lodash template() with the default evaluate pattern enabled, allowing workspace admins to execute arbitrary code via notification templates.
items.reason_zh: Tianji 分析平台将用户可控的模板传入 lodash template() 函数，并默认启用 evaluate 模式，致使工作区管理员可通过通知模板执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: The undici HTTP client library crashes Node.js processes when handling malicious responses with excessive content codings, causing widespread web application denial of service.
items.reason_zh: undici HTTP 客户端库在处理包含过量内容编码的恶意响应时会导致 Node.js 进程崩溃，引发广泛的 Web 应用拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Deactivated OTRS accounts retain valid JWT tokens for up to 16 hours, allowing unauthorized access even after credential changes or account suspension.
items.reason_zh: 已停用的 OTRS 账户最多可保留 16 小时的有效 JWT 令牌，即便在修改凭证或暂停账户后，仍可导致未授权访问。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Kong Gateway's Hybrid Mode clustering RPC logic enables unauthorized database access and potential cluster-wide compromise.
items.reason_zh: Kong Gateway 混合模式下的集群 RPC 逻辑存在 SQL 注入漏洞，可导致未授权数据库访问及潜在的集群级沦陷。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Tuleap Enterprise Edition allows arbitrary command execution on the server, severely compromising development workflow platforms.
items.reason_zh: Tuleap Enterprise Edition 存在操作系统命令注入漏洞，可在服务器上执行任意命令，严重危及开发工作流平台的安全。

items.reason_en: YAML parser recursion flaw in Symfony causes stack exhaustion or denial of service when processing deeply nested inline collections.
items.reason_zh: Symfony 的 YAML 解析器存在递归缺陷，在处理深度嵌套的内联集合时会导致栈耗尽或拒绝服务（DoS）。

items.reason_en: Incorrect header parsing in Symfony's HeaderUtils allows request smuggling or security control bypass due to flawed whitespace handling patterns.
items.reason_zh: Symfony 的 HeaderUtils 组件存在头部解析缺陷，因空白字符处理逻辑不当，可导致 HTTP 请求走私或安全控制绕过。

items.reason_en: ActivityPub actor verification flaw in Discourse allows federated posts from unverified sources, undermining community moderation and platform integrity.
items.reason_zh: Discourse 的 ActivityPub 实体验证机制存在缺陷，允许接收未经验证来源的联邦帖子，损害社区审核能力与平台完整性。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Lychee bypasses storage root restrictions, exposing arbitrary files due to flawed prefix validation logic.
items.reason_zh: Lychee 存在路径遍历漏洞，因前缀验证逻辑缺陷可绕过存储根目录限制，导致任意文件泄露。

items.reason_en: Whitelist bypass in TeamCity build messages protocol enables remote code execution, jeopardizing CI/CD pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: TeamCity 构建消息协议存在白名单绕过漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，严重威胁 CI/CD 流水线安全。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in ASP.NET Core allows privilege escalation, undermining secure web authentication flows.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 存在密码学签名验证缺陷，可导致权限提升，破坏安全的 Web 身份验证流程。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in TeamCity project overview persists malicious scripts, compromising developer accounts and collaborative workflows.
items.reason_zh: TeamCity 项目概览页面存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，恶意脚本将被持久化保存，进而危及开发者账户与协作工作流。

items.reason_en: Server-side deserialization in Microsoft Bing enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, severely impacting web service availability.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bing 存在服务端反序列化漏洞，可导致未授权远程代码执行，严重影响 Web 服务的可用性。

items.reason_en: Unsafe use of PHP's extract() combined with SQL injection in WeGIA allows attackers to bypass authentication and manipulate database records.
items.reason_zh: WeGIA 中 PHP 的 extract() 函数使用不当并与 SQL 注入漏洞结合，使攻击者可绕过身份验证并篡改数据库记录。

items.reason_en: Open redirect vulnerability in M365 Copilot facilitates phishing and privilege escalation attacks by redirecting users to untrusted sites.
items.reason_zh: M365 Copilot 存在开放重定向漏洞，攻击者可借此将用户重定向至恶意网站，从而实施网络钓鱼与权限提升攻击。

items.reason_en: Stored cross-site scripting in n8n's file preview modal executes malicious scripts in victim browsers, compromising workflow automation security.
items.reason_zh: n8n 的文件预览弹窗存在存储型跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞，可在受害者浏览器中执行恶意脚本，危及工作流自动化安全。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Link Whisper plugin enables object injection and remote code execution in WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: Link Whisper 插件存在不可信数据反序列化漏洞，可导致 WordPress 站点发生对象注入与远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in WeGIA web manager allows direct database manipulation and mass data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: WeGIA 网页管理器存在未授权 SQL 注入漏洞，可直接操控数据库并导致大规模数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Unsafe PHP deserialization in EspoCRM allows authenticated administrators to achieve remote code execution via background tasks.
items.reason_zh: EspoCRM 存在不安全的 PHP 反序列化漏洞，已认证管理员可利用后台任务实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Privilege escalation in Fluent CRM lets low-privilege users assume administrator roles and compromise entire customer databases.
items.reason_zh: Fluent CRM 存在权限提升漏洞，低权限用户可借此获取管理员权限，进而危及整个客户数据库。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Adobe Experience Manager enables arbitrary code execution and session hijacking without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Experience Manager 存在关键身份验证绕过漏洞，无需用户交互即可实现任意代码执行与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated authProcess cookie in Diaple Stela allows complete authentication bypass and unauthorized user impersonation.
items.reason_zh: Diaple Stela 中未经验证的 authProcess Cookie 可导致完整的身份验证绕过及未授权的用户身份伪造。

items.reason_en: Alternate path authentication bypass in MOVEit Transfer circumvents security controls, facilitating unauthorized file access.
items.reason_zh: MOVEit Transfer 存在替代路径身份验证绕过漏洞，可规避安全控制措施，导致未授权的文件访问。

items.reason_en: OAuth state value reuse in Better Auth enables unauthenticated account takeover by converting state tokens into magic links.
items.reason_zh: Better Auth 存在 OAuth state 值重用漏洞，攻击者可通过将 state 令牌转换为魔术链接实现未授权账户接管。

items.reason_en: Kernel-side SMB server fails to restrict caseless path resolution, allowing attackers to escape share boundaries and access unauthorized files over the network.
items.reason_zh: 内核级 SMB 服务器未限制不区分大小写的路径解析，攻击者可借此突破共享边界，通过网络访问未授权文件。

items.reason_en: Unvalidated DataOffset in SMB coalesce_t2 function enables out-of-bounds memory access when processing malicious server responses, risking credential theft or RCE.
items.reason_zh: SMB 的 coalesce_t2 函数中未经验证的 DataOffset 字段在处理恶意服务器响应时可导致越界内存访问，存在凭证窃取或远程代码执行（RCE）风险。

items.reason_en: Template engine injection vulnerability enables remote code execution on Adobe Commerce, threatening e-commerce platforms handling sensitive customer and transaction data.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce 模板引擎注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁处理敏感客户和交易数据的电子商务平台。

items.reason_en: Unbounded O(n²) JSON validation loop in Eclipse Vert.x allows remote denial-of-service attacks, impacting modern reactive web frameworks widely adopted in cloud-native applications.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Vert.x 中无界的 O(n²) JSON 验证循环可导致远程拒绝服务攻击，影响云原生应用中广泛采用的现代响应式 Web 框架。

items.reason_en: Improper trust of HTTP request headers allows attackers to bypass standard login procedures and impersonate administrators in popular helpdesk management systems.
items.reason_zh: 对 HTTP 请求头的不当信任使攻击者能够绕过标准登录流程，在流行的帮助台管理系统中冒充管理员。

items.reason_en: Authorization flaw in the bulk action dispatcher allows authenticated users to trigger privileged operations without proper role verification, risking data manipulation in accounting platforms.
items.reason_zh: 批量操作调度器中的授权缺陷允许已认证用户在未进行适当角色验证的情况下触发特权操作，导致会计平台面临数据篡改风险。

items.reason_en: Missing DACLOFFSET validation in SMB client ACL parsing allows attackers to forge permissions or bypass access controls on shared drives.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端 ACL 解析中缺失 DACLOFFSET 验证，使攻击者能够伪造权限或绕过共享驱动器的访问控制。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in SMB symlink_data function exposes sensitive kernel memory when processing malicious network shares.
