items.reason_zh: io_uring/zctx 的链式通知上下文检查机制可防止状态歧义损坏，确保现代 Linux 环境中异步 I/O 处理的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in qede_tpa_cont/end loops protects network drivers from crashing due to malformed completion queues, improving overall system resilience.
items.reason_zh: 修复 qede_tpa_cont/end 循环中的越界读取漏洞，可防止因格式错误的完成队列导致网络驱动程序崩溃，从而提升系统整体稳定性。

items.reason_en: Null pointer dereference on zero-length checksum in sunrpc mitigates authentication bypass attempts in Kerberos-based middleware and directory services.
items.reason_zh: 修复 sunrpc 中零长度校验和的空指针解引用漏洞，可有效防范基于 Kerberos 的中间件与目录服务遭受认证绕过攻击。

items.reason_en: Implements constant-time MAC comparison for IPv6 Segment Routing, preventing timing side-channel attacks that could compromise routing security through cryptographic analysis.
items.reason_zh: 为 IPv6 段路由实现恒定时间 MAC 比较机制，可防止通过密码分析危及路由安全的时序侧信道攻击。

items.reason_en: Fixes improper TLS alert handling in the sunrpc server, preventing unexpected connection drops and potential man-in-the-middle exploits in NFS-over-TLS deployments.
items.reason_zh: 修复 sunrpc 服务器中不恰当的 TLS 警报处理逻辑，可防止意外连接断开，并阻断 NFS over TLS 部署中潜在的中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Ext4 filesystem out-of-bounds read during extended attribute inode reference decrement risks data corruption or sensitive information leakage.
items.reason_zh: 在递减扩展属性inode引用计数时，Ext4文件系统存在越界读取漏洞，可能导致数据损坏或敏感信息泄露。

items.reason_en: HugeTLB page table unsharing occurs too early in VMA split, violating locking semantics and triggering memory corruption under heavy workloads.
items.reason_zh: HugeTLB页表在VMA拆分过程中过早解除共享，违反了锁语义，在高负载下可能触发内存损坏。

items.reason_en: ECDSA cryptographic module vulnerable to integer overflows in key size calculations, potentially weakening secure communication implementations.
items.reason_zh: ECDSA加密模块在密钥长度计算中存在整数溢出漏洞，可能削弱安全通信实现的安全性。

items.reason_en: s390 PKEY subsystem lacks overflow checks for userspace-controlled ioctl sizes, risking heap corruption and potential privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: s390 PKEY子系统缺乏对用户空间控制的ioctl大小进行溢出检查的机制，存在堆损坏及潜在提权风险。

items.reason_en: Reverts a problematic SMB client fix that introduced null-pointer dereferences after module removal, restoring core filesystem stability.
items.reason_zh: 回退了一个有问题的SMB客户端修复补丁，该补丁在模块卸载后引入了空指针解引用问题，此举恢复了核心文件系统的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Adds mutual exclusion to SCTP UDP port operations, preventing general protection faults and crashes during concurrent socket state changes.
items.reason_zh: 为SCTP UDP端口操作添加互斥机制，防止在并发套接字状态变更期间发生通用保护错误和系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Implements RCU protection for disk conventional zone bitmaps, eliminating invalid memory references during dynamic disk revalidation in the block layer.
items.reason_zh: 为磁盘常规区域位图实现RCU保护，消除块层动态磁盘重新验证期间的无效内存引用。

items.reason_en: Preemption handling flaws in BPF event output can trigger kernel crashes during eBPF program execution, affecting system observability and debugging tools.
items.reason_zh: BPF事件输出中的抢占处理缺陷可在eBPF程序执行期间触发内核崩溃，影响系统可观测性与调试工具。

items.reason_en: Resource leaks in the devfreq power management subsystem degrade system efficiency and may cause memory exhaustion across general-purpose Linux deployments.
items.reason_zh: devfreq电源管理子系统存在资源泄漏问题，会降低系统效率，并可能在通用Linux部署中导致内存耗尽。

items.reason_en: Missing boundary check in SELinux put_entry allows out-of-bounds memory access in mandatory access control policies.
items.reason_zh: SELinux的put_entry函数缺少边界检查，允许在强制访问控制策略中发生越界内存访问。

items.reason_en: Premature freeing of unfinalized bpf_prog_pack corrupts JIT compilation state and destabilizes kernel eBPF execution.
items.reason_zh: 未完成的bpf_prog_pack被过早释放会破坏JIT编译状态，导致内核eBPF执行不稳定。

items.reason_en: Incorrect bank_map size limits machine check error handling on modern AMD processors, masking hardware faults.
items.reason_zh: 错误的bank_map尺寸限制了现代AMD处理器上的机器检查错误处理能力，可能掩盖硬件故障。

items.reason_en: The Linux kernel net/tls subsystem contains a slab-out-of-bounds bug in decrypt_internal due to incorrect IV size calculations, potentially leading to memory corruption and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核net/tls子系统的decrypt_internal函数因IV尺寸计算错误存在slab越界访问漏洞，可能导致内存损坏与权限提升。

items.reason_en: containerd-shim-wasmtime-v1 trusts precompiled Wasm bytes from OCI image layers as native code, allowing attackers to deserialize and execute arbitrary payloads during workload initialization.
items.reason_zh: containerd-shim-wasmtime-v1将OCI镜像层中的预编译Wasm字节码视为原生代码信任执行，攻击者可在工作负载初始化期间反序列化并执行任意载荷。

items.reason_en: DPDK lib/vhost suffers from a TOCTOU double-fetch vulnerability in VDUSE control-queue descriptors, enabling heap buffer overflow and potential host compromise in virtualized environments.
items.reason_zh: DPDK lib/vhost在VDUSE控制队列描述符中存在TOCTOU竞态条件双重获取漏洞，可导致堆缓冲区溢出，在虚拟化环境中引发主机沦陷风险。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in HPE NonStop XABroker can cause memory corruption and application crashes, impacting high-availability enterprise transaction processing.
items.reason_zh: HPE NonStop XABroker存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致内存损坏与应用崩溃，影响高可用性企业事务处理。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification flaw in DigiDoc libraries allows creation of forged digital signatures that appear valid, undermining legal and administrative trust.
items.reason_zh: DigiDoc库存在密码学签名验证缺陷，允许生成看似有效的伪造数字签名，破坏法律与行政层面的可信度。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Ghostscript PDFwrite enables remote code execution when processing maliciously crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: Ghostscript PDFwrite存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，在处理恶意构造的文档时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Improper IV/counter handling in Bouncy Castle CTR mode may compromise encryption integrity, risking data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: Bouncy Castle的CTR模式对IV/计数器处理不当可能破坏加密完整性，危及数据机密性。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in elixir-protobuf JSON decoding causes application crashes, enabling denial of service via deeply nested payloads.
items.reason_zh: elixir-protobuf的JSON解码过程存在不受控递归问题，会导致应用崩溃，攻击者可利用深层嵌套载荷实施拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in .NET Framework enables network denial of service, disrupting legacy application hosting environments.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework存在输入验证不当漏洞，可导致网络拒绝服务攻击，破坏遗留应用程序托管环境。

items.reason_en: Nil response header schema handling in kin-openAPI bypasses validation checks, allowing malformed API responses to pass undetected in Go-based applications.
items.reason_zh: kin-openAPI对空响应头模式的处理会绕过验证检查，导致Go应用中畸形API响应能够未被检测地通过。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in GitPython enables remote attackers to read arbitrary files by exploiting branch name parsing during repository cloning operations.
items.reason_zh: GitPython存在参数注入漏洞，攻击者可利用克隆仓库时的分支名解析缺陷读取任意文件。

items.reason_en: Insecure logging in vLLM orchestrator gateway exposes personally identifiable information and bearer tokens in persistent logs, creating significant data leakage risks.
items.reason_zh: vLLM编排器网关存在不安全的日志记录机制，会在持久化日志中暴露个人身份信息和Bearer令牌，造成严重的数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in HPE NonStop SNMP Trap Multiplexer threatens stability of enterprise mainframe transaction processing systems.
items.reason_zh: HPE NonStop SNMP Trap Multiplexer存在内存损坏漏洞，威胁企业大型机事务处理系统的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Symlink and hardlink validation bypass in Ludwig AI framework enables filesystem manipulation during model training pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Ludwig AI框架存在符号链接与硬链接验证绕过漏洞，可在模型训练流水线中实现文件系统篡改。

items.reason_en: Key flag confusion in Sequoia OpenPGP undermines cryptographic signature verification for secure email and document workflows.
items.reason_zh: Sequoia OpenPGP存在密钥标志混淆漏洞，破坏了安全邮件与文档工作流中的密码学签名验证。

items.reason_en: Jetty HttpClient follows redirects using original path matching, leaking authentication credentials to unintended target domains.
items.reason_zh: Jetty HttpClient在重定向时使用原始路径匹配，导致认证凭据泄露至非预期的目标域名。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in HPE NonStop NDSREST threatens execution flow integrity in mission-critical mainframe environments.
items.reason_zh: HPE NonStop NDSREST存在堆缓冲区溢出漏洞，威胁关键任务大型机环境中的执行流程完整性。

items.reason_en: Linux BPF verifier relaxation allows out-of-bounds struct accesses that bypass default safety checks.
items.reason_zh: Linux BPF验证器的规则放宽允许越界结构体访问，从而绕过默认安全检查。

items.reason_en: Restricting untrusted BTF pointer writes in Linux kernel prevents unauthorized memory modifications in eBPF programs.
items.reason_zh: 限制 Linux 内核中不受信任的 BTF 指针写入，可防止 eBPF 程序中的未授权内存修改。

items.reason_en: Crafted Btrfs images trigger slab-out-of-bounds during LZO decompression, allowing local attackers to crash the system or escalate privileges via malicious disk images.
items.reason_zh: 构造的 Btrfs 镜像在 LZO 解压缩期间会触发 slab 越界访问漏洞，允许本地攻击者通过恶意磁盘镜像导致系统崩溃或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heartbeat region race conditions in Oracle Cluster File System can cause cluster node misidentification and data corruption in shared storage environments.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Cluster File System 中的心跳区域竞态条件可能导致共享存储环境中的集群节点误识别和数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized memory in NFS callback sequence decoding can lead to arbitrary code execution when interacting with malicious NFS servers.
items.reason_zh: NFS 回调序列解码中的未初始化内存问题在与恶意 NFS 服务器交互时可能导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Known exploited fragmentation accounting flaw in the IPv6 stack destabilizes network packet processing and facilitates targeted denial-of-service attacks.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 协议栈中已知被利用的分片计费缺陷会导致网络数据包处理不稳定，并助长定向拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Double-free bug in the Fibre Channel SCSI driver can trigger kernel panics or arbitrary code execution under concurrent workload scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Fibre Channel SCSI 驱动程序中的双重释放漏洞在并发工作负载场景下可能触发内核恐慌或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Recursive entity expansion in libexpat causes stack exhaustion, affecting countless applications and middleware components that rely on XML parsing.
items.reason_zh: libexpat 中的递归实体扩展会导致栈耗尽，影响无数依赖 XML 解析的应用程序和中间件组件。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of MAY_BACKLOG requests in pcrypt crypto module introduces race conditions affecting cryptographic operations.
items.reason_zh: pcrypt 加密模块对 MAY_BACKLOG 请求的处理不当引入了竞态条件，影响加密操作。

items.reason_en: Fanotify permission check false positives may inadvertently bypass mandatory access control policies across the system.
items.reason_zh: Fanotify 权限检查的误报可能导致无意中绕过整个系统的强制访问控制策略。

items.reason_en: Incorrect checksum offload fallback for IPv6 extension headers risks packet corruption in generic network stacks.
items.reason_zh: IPv6 扩展头校验和卸载回退机制错误，可能导致通用网络协议栈中的数据包损坏。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV, this Linux crypto API regression in AEAD processing is actively exploited in the wild, degrading TLS/SSL performance and stability across enterprise Linux distributions.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已列入 CISA KEV 目录，此 Linux 加密 API 在 AEAD 处理中的回归缺陷已在野外被积极利用，导致企业级 Linux 发行版中的 TLS/SSL 性能和稳定性下降。

items.reason_en: Ext4 filesystem infinite loop during logical-to-physical block mapping causes local denial of service and potential system hangs during directory creation or modification operations.
items.reason_zh: Ext4 文件系统在进行逻辑到物理块映射时出现无限循环，导致本地拒绝服务，并在目录创建或修改操作期间可能导致系统挂起。

items.reason_en: Linux RxRPC silently processes undecryptable response tickets without validation, creating a pathway for authentication spoofing and compromising secure RPC communications.
items.reason_zh: Linux RxRPC 在未经验证的情况下静默处理无法解密的响应票据，为身份验证欺骗开辟路径，从而破坏安全 RPC 通信。

items.reason_en: SIP Content-Length header truncation in the Linux netfilter conntrack helper leads to protocol parsing failures and may allow signaling bypasses in VoIP and unified communications environments.
items.reason_zh: Linux netfilter conntrack 辅助程序中 SIP Content-Length 头部截断会导致协议解析失败，并可能在 VoIP 和统一通信环境中允许信令绕过。

items.reason_en: Concurrent write flaw in Linux kernel af_alg causes unpredictable data interleaving and crypto state inconsistency, actively exploited in the wild.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 af_alg 中的并发写入缺陷会导致不可预测的数据交错和加密状态不一致，且已在野外被积极利用。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in asymmetric key ID generation can corrupt cryptographic identifiers, undermining secure boot and certificate validation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 非对称密钥 ID 生成过程中的整数溢出可能破坏加密标识符，削弱安全启动和证书验证机制。

items.reason_en: /proc inode instantiation race condition allows use-after-free during module removal, potentially crashing systems or enabling privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: /proc inode 实例化竞态条件允许在模块移除期间发生释放后使用漏洞，可能导致系统崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Critical DMA mapping flaw causing immediate kernel oops on affected hardware, severely impacting system availability and stability.
items.reason_zh: 关键的 DMA 映射缺陷会在受影响硬件上立即引发内核 Oops，严重影响系统可用性和稳定性。

items.reason_en: Fixes a time-of-check-to-time-of-use race condition during file execution that could enable unauthorized privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 修复了文件执行期间的检查时使用（TOCTOU）竞态条件，该条件可能导致未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: BPF verifier bypass allowing out-of-bounds writes, posing a significant threat for container sandbox escapes and kernel exploitation.
items.reason_zh: BPF 验证器绕过漏洞允许越界写入，对容器沙箱逃逸和内核利用构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Corrects BPF verifier logic to prevent unprivileged users from bypassing memory safety checks, significantly reducing the kernel attack surface.
items.reason_zh: 修正 BPF 验证器逻辑，防止无特权用户绕过内存安全检查，显著减少内核攻击面。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free in filesystem tree traversal that could be triggered by crafted directory structures to crash the system or execute code.
items.reason_zh: 修复了文件系统树遍历中的释放后使用漏洞，该漏洞可通过构造的目录结构触发，导致系统崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: Prevents out-of-bounds memory writes during SMB encryption operations, mitigating exploitation risks when connecting to untrusted file servers.
items.reason_zh: 防止 SMB 加密操作期间的越界内存写入，降低连接不受信任的文件服务器时的利用风险。

items.reason_en: Xilinx crypto driver calling finalize with bottom halves enabled triggers kernel warnings and potential DoS in cryptographic operations.
items.reason_zh: Xilinx 加密驱动在底半部启用状态下调用 finalize 会触发内核警告，并可能导致加密操作中的拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: BPF stack access size integer overflow protection gap could allow malicious eBPF programs to corrupt kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: BPF 栈访问大小整数溢出保护缺失，可能允许恶意 eBPF 程序破坏内核内存。

items.reason_en: WireGuard peer cleanup logic flaw may dereference invalid pointers, disrupting secure VPN tunnels in containerized and edge environments.
items.reason_zh: WireGuard 对等体清理逻辑缺陷可能解引用无效指针，破坏容器化和边缘环境中的安全 VPN 隧道。

items.reason_en: BPF DEVMAP_HASH overflow check failure on 32-bit architectures permits out-of-bounds memory allocation, threatening lightweight OS deployments.
items.reason_zh: 32 位架构上 BPF DEVMAP_HASH 溢出检查失败允许越界内存分配，威胁轻量级操作系统部署。
